title: CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. translated_title: CAST：面向跨分词器在线策略蒸馏的信用对齐
translated_abstract: 跨分词器在线策略蒸馏（OPD）需要在对教师与学生模型的分数进行比较之前，先对齐二者的序列。基于解码文本的对齐方式可以在块级别提供这种对应关系，但遗留了一个尚未解决的关键问题：信用对齐。块级信号只指定了某个片段应该改变多少，却没有说明该信号应如何在学生的各个令牌之间分配，同时缺乏教师对应关系的令牌则不受任何约束。我们提出了CAST（基于块感知的信用分配与选择性令牌锚定），一个“移动或保持”（shift-or-stay）框架，同时解决上述两个问题。对于已对齐的块，CAST利用预测不确定性和局部教师信号平滑度，将每个块的优势重新分配到学生令牌上，在保留块总优势的同时，强调由局部一致教师反馈所支持的学习机会。所得权重精确求解了一个经KL正则化的信用分配问题。
tldr: CAST提出了一种跨分词器在线蒸馏中的“移动或保持”信用对齐框架，利用预测不确定性和教师信号平滑度将块级优势精确分配到学生令牌上，并对无教师对应的令牌施加锚定约束。
en_tdlr: CAST introduces a shift-or-stay credit alignment framework for cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation, redistributing chunk-level advantages to student tokens using predictive uncertainty and teacher-signal smoothness while anchoring tokens lacking teacher correspondence.
